Alpine plant communities with traits (aravo) in long format

Source: R/traits.R
data_aravo.Rd

Converts the aravo data of the ade4 package (Choler 2005) into the long format used by tidydiversity: 82 alpine plant species in 75 sites in the Aravo valley (French Alps), with 6 site variables (including snowmelt date, Snow, and physical disturbance, PhysD) and 8 functional traits. The data are loaded from ade4, not copied into tidydiversity.

Usage

data_aravo()

Value

A list with community (a tibble with site, species, cover (abundance class 0-5) and the site variables) and traits (a tibble with species and the 8 traits).

References

Choler, P. (2005). Consistent shifts in Alpine plant traits along a mesotopographical gradient. Arctic, Antarctic, and Alpine Research, 37, 444-453. doi:10.1657/1523-0430(2005)037[0444:CSIAPT]2.0.CO;2

Examples

aravo <- data_aravo()
aravo$community
